title: NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Rule on Writable Limits and Deductibles
content:
### Writable limits and deductibles

This rule governs the limits and deductibles that may be written on NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own), at issue and on every endorsement or coverage update.

1. **Building coverage** may be written only on a tier on which building coverage is available, and the building limit may not exceed that tier's statutory maximum building coverage; the contents limit may not exceed the tier's statutory maximum contents coverage.
2. **Increments.** Both limits are written in whole multiples of the tier's coverage increment, and for a residential condominium unit the building limit is further held to the building replacement cost value stated on the application.
3. **Deductible options.** Each deductible must be one of the tier's listed options and may not exceed the tier's highest deductible.
4. **Minimum building deductible.** The minimum building deductible is the tier's lower minimum when the building limit is at or below the tier's deductible threshold, and the tier's higher minimum when the building limit is above it; the minimum contents deductible is the tier's minimum contents deductible.
5. **Separate election.** Building and contents deductibles are elected separately and may differ.
6. **Defaults.** An application or endorsement that elects no deductible takes the tier's default building deductible and default contents deductible, raised to the applicable minimum if the default falls below it.
7. **Out-of-bounds requests.** A limit or deductible outside these bounds is not written as requested: the request is written at the nearest permitted value only when the customer accepts that value, and otherwise it is not processed.

The figures this rule reads (the statutory maximums, the coverage increment, the elective deductible amounts, the minimums, the deductible threshold, the defaults and the highest deductible) are the tier figures of the product's coverage-limit and deductible schedules.

### Condition and result

| Condition on the request | Result |
|---|---|
| Building limit asked for on a tier where building coverage is not available | Outside the bounds |
| Building limit above the tier's statutory maximum, or contents limit above the contents maximum | Outside the bounds |
| A limit that is not a whole multiple of the coverage increment | Outside the bounds |
| Condominium unit building limit above the replacement cost value stated on the application | Outside the bounds |
| Deductible not among the tier's listed options, above the highest deductible or below the applicable minimum | Outside the bounds |
| A request outside the bounds whose nearest permitted value the customer accepts | Written at that nearest permitted value |
| A request outside the bounds whose nearest permitted value the customer does not accept | Not processed |

*Hypothetical boundary.* On a tier whose threshold is a building limit of 100000 dollars, a building limit of exactly 100000 dollars falls "at or below" the threshold and takes the lower minimum building deductible; a building limit one increment higher falls "above" it and takes the higher minimum.
